simple.meaning: לַעַג (laʻag) is a Hebrew word meaning “derision , scoffing.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: לַעַג (H3933) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 34:7, with occurrences in Job, Psalms, Ezekiel, Hosea.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לַעַג (H3933) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לַעַג (H3933) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: לַעַג (laʻag) / H3933 is traced through Job 34:7, Psalms 44:14, Psalms 79:4, Psalms 123:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

occurrences.englishText: You make us a byword among the nations,
We have become a reproach to our neighbors,
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease,

therefore, you mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh: The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which have become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are all around;
They return, but not to the Most High.
